name: port-light
description: Port occupancy map for a Docker host. Shows host listeners and container mappings in a traffic-light grid. Compose scanning is optional. Can pull occupancy JSON from other Port-Light instances. Includes a CLI and MCP server for port checks and reservations.

paths.name: Compose stacks
paths.description: Optional folder of Compose projects (read-only). Leave empty if unused. After mapping a folder, enable Compose in Port-Light Settings - Machines & scanning.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Docker API socket; a read-only mount does not restrict Docker API permissions

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Settings, reservations, manual entries, CLI credentials, and SQLite history

variables.name: Enabled scanners
variables.description: Default sources: listen,docker. Add compose only after mapping Compose stacks. Saved scanner choices in Port-Light Settings take precedence.

variables.name: HIDDEN_UNLOCK_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional password to reveal hidden ports in the API

variables.name: AGENT_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional token required for allocation and recovery requests

variables.name: THEME_PALETTE
variables.description: Optional named palette (gruvbox, catppuccin, nord, …); empty uses the built-in colors

variables.name: LOCALE
variables.description: auto, en, fr, de, es, zh-CN, zh-TW, or ja
